name: Indian Spiced Chicken Tacos with Tomato Raita & Cilantro-Carrot Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
1 ½ tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the shallot along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the raita. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, fill with chicken, then top with raita. Serve with carrot salad on the side and enjoy!
